import os, stat, json, hashlib, pathlib, datetime, time
PLAN = pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/c714f5bce554/continuation-checkpoints-20261116/green-binding-staging-plan-20261117.json')
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
clock = time.monotonic()
plan = json.loads(PLAN.read_text())
def identity(data):
 return {'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'gitBlob':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()}
def owned_dir(value):
 p=pathlib.Path(value); s=p.lstat()
 assert stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode) and not p.is_symlink() and stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)==0o700 and s.st_uid==os.getuid() and p.resolve()==p, value
 return {'path':str(p),'device':s.st_dev,'inode':s.st_ino,'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':oct(stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode))}
def owned_file(value,pin):
 p=pathlib.Path(value); a=p.lstat()
 assert stat.S_ISREG(a.st_mode) and not p.is_symlink() and stat.S_IMODE(a.st_mode)==0o600 and a.st_uid==os.getuid() and p.resolve()==p, value
 data=p.read_bytes(); b=p.lstat()
 assert (a.st_dev,a.st_ino,a.st_mode,a.st_uid,a.st_size,a.st_mtime_ns)==(b.st_dev,b.st_ino,b.st_mode,b.st_uid,b.st_size,b.st_mtime_ns), value
 assert identity(data)==pin, value
 return {'path':str(p),'identity':pin,'device':b.st_dev,'inode':b.st_ino,'uid':b.st_uid,'mode':oct(stat.S_IMODE(b.st_mode)),'size':b.st_size,'mtimeNs':b.st_mtime_ns}
gate_path=pathlib.Path(plan['gateLocalPath'])
assert gate_path.is_file() and not gate_path.is_symlink()
gate_bytes=gate_path.read_bytes()
assert identity(gate_bytes)==plan['publicationGate']
gate=json.loads(gate_bytes)
assert gate['gateAccepted'] is True and gate['actualCommit']==plan['publication']
roots_before=[owned_dir(plan[k]) for k in ['scopeRoot','controlRoot','replicaRoot']]
controls=pathlib.Path(plan['controlRoot']); replicas=pathlib.Path(plan['replicaRoot'])
assert sorted(p.name for p in controls.iterdir())==['combined-runner.py','red-binding.json']
assert sorted(p.name for p in replicas.iterdir())==sorted(pathlib.Path(r['path']).name for r in plan['replicas'])
for path in plan['forbiddenPreexistingPhasePaths']: assert not os.path.lexists(path), path
binding=pathlib.Path(plan['bindingLocalPath'])
assert binding.parent==controls and not os.path.lexists(binding)
rows=[{'path':plan['runnerPath'],'identity':plan['runner']},{'path':plan['redBindingPath'],'identity':plan['redBinding']},*plan['replicas']]
before=[owned_file(r['path'],r['identity']) for r in rows]
parts=[]; part_reads=[]
for row in sorted(plan['partFiles'],key=lambda r:r['ordinal']):
 p=pathlib.Path(row['path']); assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()
 wrapper=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert wrapper['ordinal']==row['ordinal'] and wrapper['identity']==row['identity']
 data=wrapper['body'].encode('utf-8'); assert identity(data)==row['identity']
 parts.append(data); part_reads.append({'ordinal':row['ordinal'],'identity':identity(data),'path':str(p)})
data=b''.join(parts)
assert identity(data)==plan['binding']
cfg=json.loads(data)
assert cfg['bindingLocalPath']==str(binding) and cfg['runnerLocalPath']==plan['runnerPath'] and cfg['runnerIdentity']==plan['runner'] and cfg['phase']=='green'
assert cfg['producerR2ReviewedAndPublished'] is True and cfg['producerActualReadbackAccepted'] is True and cfg['acceptedCombinedGreen'] is None
os.umask(0o077)
fd=os.open(binding,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
try:
 view=memoryview(data)
 while view:
  n=os.write(fd,view); assert n>0; view=view[n:]
 os.fsync(fd)
finally: os.close(fd)
new_file=owned_file(str(binding),plan['binding'])
after=[owned_file(r['path'],r['identity']) for r in rows]
assert before==after
roots_after=[owned_dir(plan[k]) for k in ['scopeRoot','controlRoot','replicaRoot']]
assert roots_before==roots_after
assert sorted(p.name for p in controls.iterdir())==['combined-runner.py','green-binding.json','red-binding.json']
assert sorted(p.name for p in replicas.iterdir())==sorted(pathlib.Path(r['path']).name for r in plan['replicas'])
for path in plan['forbiddenPreexistingPhasePaths']: assert not os.path.lexists(path), path
